# Feature: Staff Onboarding

## Overview
Create a streamlined staff onboarding system that handles the entire process from invitation to account setup and initial training.

## User Stories

1. Staff Invitation
   - As a business owner
   - I want to invite new staff members
   - So they can join our platform

2. Profile Setup
   - As a new staff member
   - I want to set up my profile and preferences
   - So I can start using the system

3. Role Assignment
   - As an administrator
   - I want to assign roles during onboarding
   - So staff have proper access from day one

4. Training Management
   - As a manager
   - I want to assign training materials
   - So new staff learn our processes

5. Document Collection
   - As an HR manager
   - I want to collect required documents
   - So we maintain proper records

## Technical Tasks
- [ ] Create invitation system
- [ ] Implement profile setup wizard
- [ ] Build role assignment flow
- [ ] Create training module system
- [ ] Implement document upload
- [ ] Add progress tracking
- [ ] Create reminder system
- [ ] Implement validation checks
- [ ] Add onboarding analytics
- [ ] Create completion reporting

## Acceptance Criteria
- Invitations send properly
- Profiles set up correctly
- Roles assign accurately
- Training tracks properly
- Documents store securely
- Progress tracks accurately
- Reminders send timely
- Reports generate properly

## Technical Notes
- Use secure token system
- Implement proper storage
- Use background jobs for emails
- Cache training content
- Follow GDPR requirements
- Implement proper logging

## Estimate
- Story Points: 8
- Time Estimate: 1 week

## Dependencies
- Role Management feature
- User Management System
